game.title: New York Jets at Tennessee Titans

lede: Tennessee Titans carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#28 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tennessee Titans -5.4 with a fair total of 43.9 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tennessee Titans pass offence vs New York Jets pass defence, which sits +0.078 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
